# CSI: Clean Scene Investigators

Canonical website: https://www.cleansceneinvestigators.com/
Knowledge Center: https://answers.cleansceneinvestigators.com/
Phone: 940-654-6334
Email: dfw.csi.info@gmail.com
Legal entity: C&Z Forensics LLC
Founder and CEO: Christina Hester, former Crime Scene Investigator
Service territory: Texas, with Denton, Denton County, DFW and North Texas as the home market

## Core services
- Crime scene cleanup
- Trauma and biohazard cleanup
- Blood and bodily-fluid cleanup
- Homicide and suicide cleanup
- Unattended death cleanup
- Decomposition cleanup
- Hazardous hoarding cleanup
- Forensic odor removal
- Vehicle biohazard cleanup
- Extreme specialty cleanup
